audit.whatIsWrong: The entire full layer names Yasuo's tracked ability as 'Spirit's Refuge' — which is SHEN'S OWN W. It appears as the enemy's ability in tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns/mid/spikes/feeding/difficulty, dosFull[0], and eight report entries. Yasuo has no ability by that name; the ability the page means is Wind Wall (W, 25/23/21/19/17s).
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon Yasuo: P Way of the Wanderer, Q Steel Tempest, W Wind Wall, E Sweeping Blade, R Last Breath. Telling a Shen player to 'track Yasuo's Spirit's Refuge' is telling him to track his own cooldown as if it were the enemy's.
audit.corrected: Track Wind Wall (25s at rank 1) as the enemy cooldown; Spirit's Refuge is your own W.

audit.whatIsWrong: Second, compounding error: the page repeatedly says Wind Wall blocks Shen's Q. wants.foe[0] reads 'Windwall your Twilight Assault projectile to deny the spirit blade pull'; late says 'his Windwall can now intercept your spirit blade pull'; spikes[3].text says the same. The full layer separately claims the tracked ability 'blocks his crit autos'.
audit.why: Wind Wall is flagged blocksProjectiles. Shen's Q carries no projectile flag — Riot's own text is 'Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it', a recall of a persistent object, not a fired projectile. Nothing in Shen's kit is a projectile, so Wind Wall blocks none of it. Wind Wall also does not block basic attacks that are not projectiles, so 'blocks his crit autos' describes Shen's W, not Yasuo's.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall stops nothing in Shen's kit — your Q pull, Shadow Dash and taunt all go through it. Do not play around it as if it denies your pattern.
sources: champ-data/_kits/shen.json (Q: no projectile flag, Riot text)

audit.why: Both layers agree (Skill/Shen/Shen/Skill/Skill/Shen/Shen) and the shape is right: Shen owns 2-3 once Shadow Dash plus Spirit's Refuge can eat a full crit-auto window, contested at 4-6, with Yasuo the real threat at two crit items — which the 9/10 carry rating and the 53.13 win rate both support.

Four spikes present: Lvl 2-3 (Shadow Dash), Lvl 6 (Stand United), 1st item, and Yasuo's 2+ crit-item spike. The last one's reasoning was wrong (Wind Wall) and is corrected below, but the timing is right.

Both packet suspectNames ('Use Stand United', "Last Breath's") are FALSE POSITIVES. The packet completely missed the real defect — Shen's own W being printed as Yasuo's ability across roughly twenty full-layer fields.

edits.before: Yasuo at two crit items is a real threat — Last Breath after a knockup deals enormous burst, and his Windwall can now intercept your spirit blade pull before your pattern begins, leaving you with an uncharged Q and no shield spike. Do not trade alone into a full-build Yasuo at 35 minutes; instead, use your tank presence to peel and engage in 5v5 where his Windwall covers at most one direction. The game should be over before this point: convert the lane lead, early mid-game global presence, and first-item spike into objectives and kills rather than waiting for a late matchup that tilts toward him.
edits.after: Yasuo at two crit items is a real threat — Last Breath after a knockup deals enormous burst, and his crit damage now outruns Ki Barrier inside a single taunt window, so the trade is over before your Q comes back up. Do not trade alone into a full-build Yasuo at 35 minutes; instead, use your tank presence to peel and engage in 5v5 where Wind Wall covers at most one direction and stops nothing in your own kit. The game should be over before this point: convert the lane lead, early mid-game global presence, and first-item spike into objectives and kills rather than waiting for a late matchup that tilts toward him.

notes: Two serious defects here, neither flagged by the packet. (1) Shen's own W, Spirit's Refuge, was printed as Yasuo's tracked ability throughout the full layer — I fixed the highest-traffic fields (tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus, cooldowns, dosFull[0], report[5]), but the same substring still remains in breakdown.mid, breakdown.spikes, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.difficulty, breakdown.trading, ahead, phases[1].why, phases[3].why, phases[5].why, report[1].t, report[3].t, report[9].t, report[10].t, report[12].t and report[13].t. A global replace of 'Spirit’s Refuge' with 'Wind Wall' in the Yasuo full entry only — note the curly apostrophe — would finish it, but I did not propose those edits individually because several are short enough that the plain substitution would drop them out of the length band. (2) The page claimed Wind Wall blocks Shen's Q pull. It does not: Shen's kit contains no projectile.
